newsitem.title: USA: HNC completes Risk Data acquisition.
newsitem.headline: HNC completes Risk Data acquisition.

text.p: HNC Software Inc on Tuesday said it completed the acquisition of Risk Data Corp, a privately held, insurance information technology services firm that develops analytical benchmarking and other risk management software products primarily for insurance carriers, state funds and third party administrators.

In a statement, HNC said the acquisition is an all stock transaction valued at approximately $61 million. Based upon the terms of the agreement, HNC Software will issue approximately 1,891,465 shares of HNC common stock and 248,525 HNC stock options to the shareholders and option holders of Risk Data.
HNC Software develops, markets, integrates and supports advanced decision software based on computational intelligence.
